description: ** Python Certification Training: https://www.edureka.co/data-science-python-certification-course **  This Edureka video on  'How Netflix uses Python' is to educate you as to how this media giant makes use of Python for its success. Below are the topics covered in this video:    Introduction to Netflix How Netflix uses Python? Open Connect Demand Engineering Team Machine Learning Infrastructure Big Data Scientific Experimentation Video Encoding / Media Cloud Engineering Netflix Animation and NVFX IS (Information Security) Monitoring and Auto-Remediation  Python Tutorial Playlist: https://goo.gl/WsBpKe Blog Series: http://bit.ly/2sqmP4s  #Edureka #PythonEdureka #HowNetflixusesPython #pythonProgramming #pythonTutorial #PythonTraining   Do subscribe to our channel and hit the bell icon to never miss an update from us in the future: https://goo.gl/6ohpTV   PG in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning with NIT Warangal : https://www.edureka.co/post-graduate/machine-learning-and-ai  Post Graduate Certification in Data Science with IIT Guwahati - https://www.edureka.co/post-graduate/data-science-program  (450+ Hrs || 9 Months || 20+ Projects & 100+ Case studies)  Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/edureka_learning/   Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/edurekaIN/  Twitter: https://twitter.com/edurekain  LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/edureka   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- How it Works?  1. This is a 5 Week Instructor-led Online Course,40 hours of assignment and 20 hours of project work 2. We have a 24x7 One-on-One LIVE Technical Support to help you with any problems you might face or any clarifications you may require during the course. 3. At the end of the training, you will be working on a real-time project for which we will provide you a Grade and a Verifiable Certificate!  - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - About the Course  Edureka's Python Online Certification Training will make you an expert in Python programming. It will also help you learn Python the Big data way with integration of Machine learning, Pig, Hive and Web Scraping through beautiful soup. During our Python Certification training, our instructors will help you:  1. Master the Basic and Advanced Concepts of Python 2. Understand Python Scripts on UNIX/Windows, Python Editors and IDEs 3. Master the Concepts of Sequences and File operations 4. Learn how to use and create functions, sorting different elements, Lambda function, error handling techniques and Regular expressions ans using modules in Python 5. Gain expertise in machine learning using Python and build a Real Life Machine Learning application 6. Understand the supervised and unsupervised learning and concepts of Scikit-Learn 7. Master the concepts of MapReduce in Hadoop 8. Learn to write Complex MapReduce programs 9. Understand what is PIG and HIVE, Streaming feature in Hadoop, MapReduce job running with Python  10. Implementing a PIG UDF in Python, Writing a HIVE UDF in Python, Pydoop and/Or MRjob Basics 11. Master the concepts of Web scraping in Python 12. Work on a Real Life Project on Big Data Analytics using Python and gain Hands on Project Experience  - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Why learn Python?  Programmers love Python because of how fast and easy it is to use. Python cuts development time in half with its simple to read syntax and easy compilation feature. Debugging your programs is a breeze in Python with its built in debugger. Using Python makes Programmers more productive and their programs ultimately better. Python continues to be a favorite option for data scientists who use it for building and using Machine learning applications and other scientific computations. Python runs on Windows, Linux/Unix, Mac OS and has been ported to Java and .NET virtual machines. Python is free to use, even for the commercial products, because of its OSI-approved open source license.  Python has evolved as the most preferred Language for Data Analytics and the increasing search trends on python also indicates that Python is the next "Big Thing" and a must for Professionals in the Data Analytics domain.   Who should go for python?  Edureka’s Data Science certification course in Python is a good fit for the below professionals:  ·         Programmers, Developers, Technical Leads, Architects ·         Developers aspiring to be a ‘Machine Learning Engineer' ·         Analytics Managers who are leading a team of analysts ·         Business Analysts who want to understand Machine Learning (ML) Techniques ·         Information Architects who want to gain expertise in Predictive Analytics ·         'Python' professionals who want to design automatic predictive models   For more information, Please write back to us at [EMAIL] or call us at IND: 9606058406 / US: 18338555775 (toll free)

Welcome again. It's the wah of Edurek, who will share with us everything interesting information about how Netflix uses Python. Before we start, subscribe to our channel and click the bell icon to be up to date with Ed's latest films. Back to this session, let's start by bringing Netflix in a short time, and then move on to the following How does Netflix use Python in various sectors, such as CDN which is open, NLP, machine learning, analysis of large data sets, scientific experiments, video coding, animation, security, and finally monitoring and automatic removal of the effects of an accident no unnecessary delays, let's get started Netflix, as we all know, is an American company offering video services for the need. It has about 148 million subscribers worldwide, and this number continues to increase. Over the course of about two decades, Netflix has risen to the king of his clan in the top series and films category worldwide. As the fastest-growing brand in America and making profits and earning revenue of $ 25 billion by June 2019, Netflix grabs people's attention, and thus arouses interest in the technical sphere. Let's take a look now at how Netflix uses Python in various fields. and those companies that use this channel in their content life including the mobile network can manage their content CDN and the internet The network where Netflix is based opens and unlocks the network using open-connect by pressing the play button. The content provided to the end user is maintained by the net. Open Connect requires various additional designing and operation programs, which are written in Python. Most importantly, the network appliances they are based on is the Python application, because Python plays an important role in solving network problems. Knowing the first component, which is Open Connect, let us traffic, and managing traffic operations which allows for the maintenance of the content availability and optimalization of the fleet. The libraries used by this set are NAMPs and SCIPI, which are used for digital analysis. Boto 3 represents an integrated software set software services available for Amazon for Python's network services. It helps Python programmers integrate Python with AWS, thereby enabling the development of the infrastructure. radioQ or RQ is a Python library that helps track tasks in a queue... and enables them to be performed thereby enabling the management of asynchronous loads. Flask Netflix uses Flask to create online applications in Python. Netflix uses the API Flask interfaces to connect all previous segments. Moreover, Netflix also uses Jupyter and its interaction, which has a wide-scale expand of Jupyter. Jupyter is known for its popularity for data analysis. It is excellent for analyzing and visual of Jupyter. Jupyter is known for its popularity in data analysis. It is good at analyzing and visualizing operative data, which in turn helps in detecting capacity regressions. Now let's move on to how Python is used in machine learning. Machine learning involves both creating personalization algorithms and defining case uses. Personalization algorithms help train machine learning models according to Netflix standards. It also provides customized recommendations on-day, generate labels and the like. Observable libraries that are necessary for deep networks to be studied are Tensrflow, CAS and PyTorch. However, XGBoost and LiteGBM are the key trees, with the use of gradient technology. on the network. The main application for low-tech computing is TensorFlow, CAS and PyTorch. However, XGBoost and Light GBM serve as critical trees with using gradient technology. Netflix has also developed many high-level libraries that help include them in workplaces, such as The Big Data team also uses Metaflow to create machine learning plans. The Big Data team is responsible for implementing ETL, i.e. Extraction, Transform, Charge, and Ad-Hoc processes. A significant part of this orchestration is written in Python. The team uses a harmonogram that works on Jupyter notebooks with a paper mill to generate types of tasks with templates, for example SPARK, PRESTO and so on. In addition, the team created an event-based platform which is entirely based on Python. They created a number of events and combined them, enabling Netflix to filter React and Root events. Let's now move on to how Python is used in science experiments. This platform was created for experiments and tests A and B. A and B tests, also called split tests, lie on the comparison of two versions and determining the best performance of each. The research team can also present new innovations in terms and data visualization. A framework called Python is implemented here. It is a metric repository based on PPK which enables writing multiple parameterized questions used for the statistics sector. For calculating statistics in Python or R, there are PoI-RO and RPY-2 libraries. Plotly helps in visualizations, video coding or multimedia cloud engineering. on Netflix, by the way. What can you do in a different setting? The most convenient solution is a web browser called VRP2. The process on which you will enter such a web browser involves some changes, and you will only see what it tells you. When you want to create a new site, and you plan to have an existing site, all you have to do is select the site of information on a screen using the Picsol. The application offers a new feature in version 2, which is known as using a screen, when running the device, the screen uses a display like the one on that computer. They are connected using Python. Now let's see how Netflix uses Python to provide information security. Netflix uses Python to informatic systems, supporting automation, security automations, risk classification and so on. The most active Open Source project of this team is Security Monkey. Netflix also uses the SSH Bless, Bastion Slamp Dom Adrel to protect secuSearch Shell. The repository set is for sharing M-cornects and the TLS certificates are assigned via Lemma. Both these tasks are based mainly on python. Finally, let's look at how python is used to monitor andautomatic error repair. Group . Monitoring andautomating error correction is also known monitor and automatically fix errors. The error service support team is also known as data engineering team. They create and run tools for analysis of the operational, diagnostic, and automatic fix of errors and modifications. In most of their services this team benefits from Python. For example, Python Spectator customer library. This library is used record size time series. In addition to these libraries, products such as Winston and Bolt are also built on the framework of Python, like Flask-Unicorn and Flask-Rest+. Summing up, you can safely say that Python is the driving force of Netflix. Therefore, we have come to the end of this session. I hope that you enjoy and place a comment with your doubts and questions, and we will reply as soon as possible.
